spans.s:
(ए) हसे r. 1st cl. (हसति)
1 To laugh.
2 To laugh at, to ridicule: (this root does not take the middle voice when it implies reciprocal action, as व्यतिहसन्ति they laugh at each other.)

m. (-सः)
Laughter, laughing, laugh.
E.
हस to laugh, aff. अप्.

m. (-सः)
Laughing, laughter.
E.
हस to laugh, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
Laughing, smiling.
f. (-न्ती)
1 A portable fire-pan, a small furnace.
2 Arabian jasmine.
3 A Śākinī or female spirit attendant on DURGĀ.
E.
हस to laugh, aff. शतृ.

n. (-नं)
Laughter, laughing.
f. (-नी)
A portable fire-place or pan.
E.
हस to laugh, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-णिः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
हसनी a fire-place, and मणि a jewel.

f. (-का)
A portable furnace or fire-pan.
E.
कन् added to हसन्ती; see हसत्.

f. (-का)
Laughter.
E.
हस to laugh, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-का)
Laughter, mirth.
E.
हस to laugh, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blown, budded, (as a flower.)
2 Smiling.
n. (-तं)
1

Laughter.
2

Smiling.
3

The bow of KĀMA.
E.
हस to laugh, aff. क्त.

m. (-स्तः)
1 The hand.
2 An elephant's trunk.
3 The thirteenth lunar asterism, designated by a hand, and containing five stars, one of which is γ or δ

Corvi.
4

A head of hair, or abundance of hair.
5 A cubit measured by the hand and arm, or from the elbow to the tip of the middle finger.
6 (In prosody,) An anapæst.
n. (-स्तं)
A bellows.
E.
हस to laugh, Uṇādi aff. तन्.

n. (-नं)
Cutting off the hand.
E.
हस्त, and छेदन cutting.

n. (-लं)
1 The palm of the hand.
2 The hand.
3 The tip of an elephant's trunk.
E.
हस्त, and तल surface.

n. (-णं)
Warding off a blow, stopping, resisting, (in a conflict.)
E.
हस्त the hand, and धारण restraining.

n. (-च्छं)
The hand below the wrist.
E.
हस्त the hand, and पुच्छ tail.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
In hand, seized, held, caught hold of.
E.
हस्त, and वर्त्तिन what abides.

n. (-णं)
Resisting an assault, warding off a blow.
E.
हस्त the hand, and वारण prohibiting.

n. (-म्बं)
Perfuming the person.
E.
हस्त the hand, and विम्ब a red fruit.

n. (-त्रं)
A bracelet, one worn at the wrist.
E.
हस्त the hand, and सूत्र a string.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
In hand, held, grasped.
E.
हस्त, and स्थ what stays or is.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Held, in hand.
E.
हस्त, and स्थित staying.

m. (-क्ष्यः)
1 A lion.
2 A tiger.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, कश to hurt, स aff., and यत् added.

m. (-र्णः)
1 The castor oil tree.
2 The Butea frondosa.
3 A demi-god of a particular class.
E.
हस्तिन् an elephant, and कर्ण the ear.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-लः)
A sort of Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
हस्ति an elephant, कर्ण the ear, and दल a leaf.

m. (-न्दः)
A tree.

m. (-लिः)
A sort of jujube.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and कोलि jujube.

m. (-रिः)
The city Kāñci, a place of pilgrimage in the peninsula.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and गिरि a mountain.

f. (-षा)
A kind of creeper.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and घोषा the generic name.

m. (-घ्नः)
A man.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, घ्न who kills.

m. (-री)
An elephant-driver.
E.
हस्ति, and चारिन् who gives.

m. (-न्तः)
1 The radish.
2 A pin or bracket projecting from a wall to hang any thing upon.
n. (-न्तं)
Ivory.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and दन्त a tooth; also with कन् added, हस्तिदन्तक.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
As big as an elephant, gigantic, elephantine.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, द्वयसच् aff.

m. (-स्ती)
An elephant.
f. (-नी)
1 A female elephant.
2 A female; one of the four kinds into which they are classed, and described as of low stature, corpulent habits, curly hair, dark complexion, libidinous appetite, and furious passions.
3 A drug and perfume; also हट्टविस्नासिनी.
E.
हस्त a trunk, and इनि aff.

n. (-खं)
A sort of covered way, a raised place of earth or masonry, covering the access to the gate of a city or fort.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and नख nail.

n. (-रं)
Ancient Dehli, the capital of YUDHIṢṬHIRA and his brethren, the remains of which still exist, about 57 [] miles north-east of the modern city, on the banks of the old channel of the Ganges.
E.
हस्तिन् the name of a king, its founder, or an elephant, &c., and पुर city; also हस्तिनीपुर.

n. (-रं)
Hastināpura.
E.
हास्तिन the same, and पुर city.

m. (-पः)
An elephant rider or driver.
E.
हस्तिन् an elephant, पाल to cherish or rear, aff. क.

m. (-कः)
An elephant-driver or keeper.
E.
हस्तिप the same, and कन् aff.

f. (-र्णी)
1 A plant, commonly Moraṭā.
2 A sort of gourd, (Momordica mixta.)
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and पर्ण leaf.

m. (-दः)
The juice that exudes from an elephant's temples when in rut.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and मद the frontal juice.

m. (-ल्लः)
1 GAṆ

EŚA.
2

ŚAṄKHA, the eighth of the chief Nāgas or serpents of the infernal regions.
3 The elephant of

INDRA.
4

A heap of ashes.
5 A shower of dust.
6 Frost, cold.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and मल्ल a wrestler.

m. (-हः)
A goad.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and वाह what bears.

f. (-ला)
An elephant stall or stable.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and शाला hall.

f. (-ण्डा or ण्डी)
1 An elephant's trunk.
2 A flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.)
E.
हस्ति an elephant, शुण्डा the trunk.

n. (-णं)
Marriage.
E.
हस्त the hand in the seventh case, and करण making.

mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं)
1 Given with the hand.
2 Done with the hand, manual.
E.
हस्त the hand, यत् aff.

m. (-हः)
An elephant rider or driver.
E.
हस्ति an elephant, and आरोह who mounts.

mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं)
Stupid, ignorant, a fool.
E.
हस to laugh at or deride, रक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A buffoon.
E.
हस to laugh, causal v., वुन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Laughing, laughing at.
2 Causing laughter, merry, ridiculous.
E.
हास, कर what makes.

m. (-साः)
The moon, (in the language of the Vedas.)
E.
हा to abandon, असुन् aff., and सुट् augment.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Laughing, smiling.
E.
हस to laugh, घिनुण् aff.

n. (-कं)
A herd of elephants.
m. (-कः)
A rider on an elephant, an elephant-driver, &c.
E.
हस्तिन् an elephant, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Elephantine, large, as big as an elephant, &c.
n. (-नं)
Hastināpura, ancient Dehli.
E.
हस्तिन् a sovereign, founder of the city, or an elephant, and अण् aff. of derivation, or abundance.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Laughable, ridiculous.
n. (-स्यं)
Laughter. laughing, mirth.
E.
हस to laugh, and ण्यत् aff.
